captions.detailed: A cold-press slow juicer featuring a large, solid light-gray rectangular base with rounded vertical corners. Mounted on top are two vertical black support pillars holding a translucent dark-gray hopper funnel with a hinged lid. A horizontal translucent dark-gray cylinder extends forward to house a dark-gray helical auger. The hopper lid rotates on a revolute hinge along its back edge, while the auger rotates continuously about its horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cold-press slow juicer with a solid light-gray rectangular base, two black vertical support pillars, a translucent dark-gray hopper funnel, and a horizontal translucent auger chamber. Implement a revolute joint for the hopper lid at its rear hinge and a continuous rotational joint for the internal helical auger along the horizontal cylinder's axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main base using a filleted box primitive. Model the hopper funnel by lofting or combining box/pyramid geometries with translucent material properties, and build the horizontal extraction chamber as a translucent cylinder. Create the internal auger with a helical sweep or patterned disk segments, then define a revolute joint for the lid rotating on the hinge axis and a continuous joint for the horizontal auger rotation.
